faq.q: How old do you have to be?
faq.a: We require that renters/operators be a minimum of 18 years old, however, you can drive the ski at 16 years old with parent/guardian permission. Children 18 and younger are allowed as passengers, but are left up to the parent’s discretion. We recommend no children younger than 5 years old ride as passengers. 2: Do I have to make reservations? Although reservations are not required, it is STRONGLY recommended you make reservations to ensure availability.

quotes.author: Stephen Vesper
quotes.text: Went out on an early morning two ski rental and the whole experience was great. We got there 30 minutes early as requested. We were able to get on the water about 15 minutes early. All the expectations and water guidelines were thoroughly explained .

quotes.author: kimberly Helbling
quotes.text: The owner was knowledgeable and gave Great instructions in a very friendly format. We enjoyed ourselves immensely and highly recommend them.

quotes.author: Dustie1 hap
quotes.text: We had the time of our lives! Trevor was so thorough that even my forgetful mind remembered exactly what I needed to know. Thank you Trevor!

quotes.author: Lizzie
quotes.text: Highly recommend this business. The access point they have on the water felt like a hidden gem and the staff were very helpful and friendly.
